label: IQ score
base_noun: people who take a standardised IQ test
definition: Full-scale score on a supervised, individually administered intelligence test such as the Wechsler Adult Intelligence Scale or Stanford-Binet 5, scaled to a mean of 100 and a standard deviation of 15 against the test's same-age standardization sample.
phrasings: what IQ score is the top 1%
what IQ do you need to be in the top 1 percent
how rare is an IQ of 140
what IQ do you need for Mensa
